subject.title: feat(codex): config to disable or scope the native hook relay (#91009)

question: May `plugins.entries.codex.config.appServer.nativeHookRelay.enabled: false` intentionally disable all native hook relay behavior, including approval and policy callbacks, or must one or more safety events remain mandatory?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but it exposes an operator control that can disable a security-relevant enforcement path; code review cannot determine the product safety contract.

options.title: Permit full opt-out
options.body: Allow the explicit owner-controlled opt-out, document the lost hook/approval behavior, and require real attempt plus side-question proof before merge.

options.title: Keep safety events mandatory
options.body: Limit configuration to performance-safe event scoping while retaining `permission_request` and any required policy relay events.

options.title: Prefer the default-path repair
options.body: Land or extend the idle-PreToolUse fix first and defer this broader configuration surface until a maintainer sponsors it.

recommendation.title: Permit full opt-out
recommendation.body: Allow the explicit owner-controlled opt-out, document the lost hook/approval behavior, and require real attempt plus side-question proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent native-hook-relay lifecycle work makes Kaspre the strongest evidence-backed routing candidate for this safety-boundary decision.
